{{Top|leg}}
The '''Bureau of Tourism''' was a governmental agency on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coyn]]. They issued an advisory to all visitors to the planet to observe the [[En'Tra'Sol]], and informed them of the specifics of the law.
